description: Research/default profile: no serving format menu restrictions, but keep known runtime kernel shape constraints out of allocator candidates.
_emulation_only_rationale: Deliberately declares NO export_lane, so its menu is not bounded by any exporter. This profile exists to keep research rungs with no served path measurable end-to-end in the emulation harness (INT8_W8A16, INT4_W4A16_g128, the weight-only A16 family) -- bounding it by an exporter would delete exactly the comparisons the format menu is researched with. Nothing selected under `research` is shippable: run-pipeline's export stages resolve a real serving profile (vllm_packed_moe / gguf), whose lane bound then applies.

shape_rules.detail: vLLM/FlashInfer MXFP8 GEMM requires K >= 128, N >= 128, and K divisible by the 32-value MX block size; swizzled scale layouts pad N internally
